title: Evidence
description: Links a claim to a source with a precise locator and a support/contradict direction (docs/data/EVIDENCE_SCHEMA.md). Auditable; revisions supersede instead of deleting.

source_id.description: Every evidence record references a Source, never raw content.

locator.description: Precise locator. The contract requires the block to be present; carrying at least one locating field (quote/page/section/fragment) is a writer obligation verified in golden cases, not a v1 schema assertion.

superseded_by.description: evidence_id of the revising record; history is preserved.
